originals.why: poeni am sut ti'n mynd i is natural North Welsh. It is an open fragment, and poeni keeps the sense of worry.
mae hi wedi poeni is natural, and poeni keeps the sense of worry.
pam dw i'n poeni is a natural embedded fragment, and poeni keeps the sense of worry.

originals.ko: 나는 오늘 저녁 너무 많이 걱정하고 싶지 않아
나는 그래야 하기 전에는 걱정하고 싶지 않아
나는 내가 걱정할 필요가 있는지 확실하지 않아
나는 내가 왜 걱정하는지 확실하지 않아
originals.why: This is natural Welsh, and poeni is used in the same sense.

originals.ko: 나는 지금 당장 멈추고 싶어, 왜냐하면 나는 걱정하고 있거든
originals.why: This is natural North Welsh. rŵan hyn means right now, and poeni keeps the sense of worry.

originals.ko: 나는 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아
나는 웨일스어로 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아
나는 지금 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하고 싶지 않아
나는 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아, 왜냐하면 나는 나아지고 싶거든
나는 한 달 동안 배워 왔고 나는 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아

topups.why: This is good, but only one top-up was needed and U01 is the better example.
The Korean 실수할 거야 could also be answered with bydda i'n gwneud, so it has two possible Welsh answers.
The Korean 실수하지 않을 거야 could be answered with fydda i ddim yn gwneud or with dw i ddim yn mynd i, so it has two possible Welsh answers.
The meaning is odd and weak as a practice line.
The Korean 너 실수할 거야? could also be answered with fyddi di'n gwneud, so it has two possible Welsh answers.
In Korean, 실수하는 것은 유용해 could also mean mae gwneud camgymeriadau'n ddefnyddiol, so it has two possible Welsh answers.
